chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Hishām ibn Sālim from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who entrusts another man with a bequest, and he dislikes accepting it.
So Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “He should not abandon him in this situation.”

key_terms.بِوَصِيَّةٍ: with a bequest or testamentary charge
key_terms.لَا يَخْذُلْهُ: he should not forsake or abandon him
key_terms.يَقْبَلَهَا: to accept it, meaning to undertake the responsibility

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say about refusing to accept responsibility for a bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the case of a person asked to accept responsibility for another’s bequest. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام instructs that he should not abandon the person in such a circumstance, indicating a duty of support and responsibility in matters of trust and estate arrangements.
